notes.title: Demo Hotfix 1.2 & First Major Update: Paths and Voices
notes.notes:
We've had an incredible few weeks learning about what everyone's thoughts on the Shoni Island demo are! Utilizing the feedback we've gotten in our community Discord server, we're rolling out another hotfix as well as the first major patch since the demo's launch: Paths and Villager Voices!

Firstly, check out the notes for Demo Hotfix 1.2:



 Fixed building menu crash
 Puzzle loading/saving fix
 Right click destroy/slam conflict bug fix
 Building text info missing fixed
 fixed not all villagers sleeping/waking up
 fixed camera movement continues when pausing/autosaving etc
 fixed collision issues with some buildings
 fixed constructors not using pickups to construct
 fixed farmland destroyed plot not re-placeable/causing a crash on highlight
 fixed tree planting (loading/saving not tested)
 fixed not all UI hiding on demo end screen
 fixed demo final end screen (day 5) still showing password/continuable
 added demos for farm view and tree planting
 fixed some pickups not spawning on ground
 fixed adventurous villager wandering
 prevented sleepers from being launched (for now)
 fixed demo puzzle 1 blocking villagers


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/5cafdc357db7902298714b5bf4c50d6e20b416d6.png

Now, let's jump straight into the major update!

Paths

Players will not be able to create pathways that villagers can use to get from place to place. To get started making a path:


 LMB to make a point
 RMB to undo last point
 Spacebar to confirm (takes the last LMB point as the final one)
 RMB on a path section to remove that section

Just as they can create them, players will also be able to destroy paths by pressing RMB over them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/d2df09ebd1c4af93d0f5ebaaffa1adcd6ffe5fdc.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/5748a873c3ca0c63a46479a3f54ab177a3840d59.gif

Villager Voices

Lastly, new voice lines were recorded for villagers, so zoom in to see if you can listen in on a conversation or two next time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/dc279afc48b47d24497a9eea16e3041fbad4f4e1.gif

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 1.1
notes.notes:

Check out Demo Hotfix 1.1:


 improved character launch animations.
 kids now switch to adult animations when coming of age.
 kid t-pose on grabbed fixed.
 farms loading yellow and turning green when sown fixed.
 farm selection outline in.
 fixed timers still running after villager death.
 eyes now open and close in line with sleepe state.
 sleeping standing up fixed.
 move around while sleeping fixed.
 abp sleep transition fixed.
 fixed tutorial tree not clickable.
 adjusted crop local z location to make it more visible.
 clear timers on dead to fix crashes.
 main menu sound settings fixed.

notes.title: Shoni Island Demo Release Date
notes.notes:
The official date that you can start the demo for Shoni Island is:

☀️ March 17, 2025 🌴

Players will be placed in a demo-specific scenario that will teach them the game's core mechanics and show off all of the sweet features like the villagers' various skills, using the God Hand, building structures, gathering resources, and so much more!

We can't wait for you all to see what we've been working on for a little over a year.

See you all on the island!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/a26dea35b95e10ff91b30d89b7608afb89c0e602.png

notes.title: New Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to everyone who has wishlisted Shoni Island these last few months.

We are so close to 600 wishlists, and we couldn't be more excited to see how many we end up with when the game finally launches in early access.

That being said, there will be a change to the early access date.

Instead, Shoni Island will launch in early access on

✨March 15, 2025✨

Why? Well, we just needed some more time to polish some things and fix a few bugs before we felt reading for Shoni Island to be ready for the world.

We thank you for your patience, and we can't wait to see you in March!
